clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Anastasia Hartwell sends aspiring Horde mages to Silverpine Forest for Dalaran mana gems. They also need linen to make their first true mage's robes.

Undercity initiates gather the materials for their first true robes: a bolt of simple linen and potent Dalaran mana gems. The robes mark their station and personal worth, and Anastasia Hartwell directs the novices to harvest these raw components for an enchanted weave.

The mana gems cannot be bought or conjured. Dalaran mages are stationed across Silverpine Forest, especially near Ambermill, and the gems must be taken from them. Anastasia Hartwell says Dalaran's arcane philosophies mirror those of the Forsaken, but sentiment has no place in the Undercity. To the Forsaken, wizards too weak to defend their relics forfeit both their treasures and their lives.

Josef Gregorian, a tailor in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, receives the gathered cloth and gems. He admits he lacks the magical talent to judge the pristine quality of Dalaran's enchanted stones, but he has the rare artisan skill to weave their raw power into the robes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is time for you to don your first mage's robes, friend. They are a sign of your station, and a testament to your worth.

To gain the robes, you must gather the mana gems from the Dalaran mages of Silverpine. Their beliefs are similar to ours and so killing them is somewhat distasteful, but if they lack the strength to resist us, then they do not deserve their lives.
Bring the gems and a supply of linen to Josef Gregorian at the Magic Quarter's tailor shop.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Anastasia said you would come to me, and I am prepared to fashion your robes. Do you have the gems and the linen?

clips.title: Completion
paras: This is very good material, and although I lack the talent to gauge the quality of these mana gems, we'll soon know if they possess the power needed to create spellfire robes...
